name: custom/guide-single
title: Guide
description: Displays a Guide's full chapter accordion. Pulls its content live from the chosen Guide — nothing is duplicated into the block itself. Use this to show a Guide at a URL of your choosing (e.g. a Page whose slug is exactly "guide") — the Guide post itself also has its own permalink independently (see guide-cpt.php), this is just a second way to reach the same content.
